bundle.shortDescription: 강의 PDF를 슬라이드별로 LLM 튜터와 함께 공부하는 앱 · Study lecture PDFs with an LLM tutor
bundle.longDescription: easy-study: study lecture PDFs slide by slide with an LLM tutor (Claude Code, Codex, Claude API, OpenAI API). The app runs its own easy-study server on this computer or connects to one on another computer.
